text_block_list.text:
At Agnes Tachyon's request,
I came out to the pool in the middle of the night...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Today's experiment is: 'Let's observe muscle movements when water pressure is doubled!'"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It would be troublesome if we got caught. After all, we're adding a special chemical into the pool.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Come now, as long as we destroy all the evidence by tomorrow, everything will be fine!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us begin! Make sure you
time me accurately, won't you!

Agnes Tachyon began swimming in high spirits.
From the looks of it, the water doesn't seem any different, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... No change at all, huh.
As expected, the chemical dosage was too low relative to the water volume."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It cannot be helped. Trainer-kun, I leave the rest to you.
It would be troublesome if the chemicals underwent changes later and caused an issue.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even though the water is circulated,
it must be clinging to the floors, the railings, and everywhere else.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Clean it up thoroughly and destroy the evidence.
I'm counting on you to do a meticulous job.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~... I'm supposed to reflect on
my mistake this time, you know...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Okay, I get it.
Don't look at me with those eyes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"The experiment failed, and on top of that
I have to clean up... What an absolute disaster!"

Agnes Tachyon complained, but thanks to swimming,
she built up some muscle, making it quite
a productive use of time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Clean it up thoroughly and destroy the evidence.
I'm counting on you to do a meticulous job.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Mmh... Indeed, time-wise it might be tight.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Leaving evidence behind
and ending up in lecture territory is something I'd rather avoid.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Very well, I shall lend you a hand.
You had better be grateful!"

"Though Agnes Tachyon looked exhausted,
the swimming built her muscle strength,
making it a fruitful session."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Clean it up thoroughly and destroy the evidence.
I'm counting on you to do a meticulous job.
choice_data_list: Why don't you try it a bit more?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's futile, totally futile. As you can see, I'm afraid
there's no change in the water—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...?! Is this...
The water resistance is higher than before?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
For the density of the water to change so drastically...
Could it be that my exercising inside triggered it...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this is quite fascinating!
Trainer-kun! You must try it for yourself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And in her excited state,
she dragged me right into the pool—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, no, that's a magnificent result!
I nearly threw away precious experimental findings!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Splendid achievement, Trainer!
And it was great getting some good exercise in, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon laughed with sheer delight.
Collapsed by the poolside,
I could barely manage a nod in response.
